title: Determined
slide_intent: Teach a storyteller to show sustained effort so an audience can understand what an athlete’s achievement required.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can give the athlete’s journey a place in a story that might otherwise focus on a medal.
demonstration: A skier strides across snow toward the right side of the page. The two columns below the red heading pair perseverance with a direction to recognize the journey.
practical_value: Choose an image or sentence about the effort along the way when describing a sporting achievement.

content_islands.name: Photographic example
content_islands.spec: Preserve the skier’s stride and poles against the snow, with the mountain landscape across the upper field.

content_islands.name: Trait heading
content_islands.spec: Place the red Determined bar over the open ground on the left.

content_islands.name: Meaning and expression
content_islands.spec: Place two translucent columns beneath the label. Pair the principle of perseverance with the instruction about covering the athlete’s journey.
